title: The Hallway Track: Where Does Context Actually Live?
description:
Context isn't just what's in your docs — it's the hallway chat, the elevator conversation, the stuff living in someone's head that never got written down. In this Hallway Track conversation, we dig into what it actually takes to give an agent the right context, why the definition of "context" keeps shifting, and what has to be true before it's safe to push an agent into the background.

Part of The Hallway Track — real conversations, caught between sessions, at AI Engineer SF.
